overall_strategy: For Max, a 2-month-old Golden Retriever living in an apartment, our strategy focuses on establishing a solid foundation for his growth and training. Subscriptions include essential consumables like food and treats that are crucial for his development and training routines. One-time purchases prioritize essential setup items such as crates and cooling mats to address the immediate needs of apartment living and current weather conditions. This balanced approach ensures Max's comfort, safety, and well-being in his new home.
